messages:
Alex: Quick async check — HelixHealth dry-run tomorrow 09:00 PST. Need network + airgap owners to confirm egress IPs, artifact access, and certs. Who can own final validation?
Meera: I can own network validation. @NetOps, can you confirm the NAT egress IPs and whether the artifact bucket is reachable from the airgapped staging mirror? I hit an S3 timeout earlier.
NetOps: NAT IPs for helixhealth-tenant: 3.34.56.78, 3.34.56.79 (outbound 443 only). Artifact bucket redwood-artifacts-us-west-2 added to allowlist at 2023-07-09T15:32Z. Noted DNS CNAME flakiness — working on it.
JC: FYI image sync job is failing with a checksum mismatch on tarball. I pushed a small fix to the sync job (branch: sync/fix-checksum). PTAL: `git diff origin/main..sync/fix-checksum` — needs one more review.
Natalie: Cert rotation update: CA chain updated in staging. Will stage new certs for `helix.private.redwood` today. Need confirmation that on-prem infra accepts SNI for that host.
Ryan: For airgap signing — is the offline signing key present on the sealer box? Quick check: `ssh sealer@10.0.3.12 ls -l /keys/offline_signer.pem`
Meera: Confirmed key exists but perms were 644. Ran `chmod 600 /keys/offline_signer.pem` and re-ran packaging. Uploading signed bundle to `/tmp/helix-sigs.tar.gz` on sealer now.
Alex: Two quick asks: 1) can NetOps add an EU fallback egress route if us-west gets congested? 2) post the smoke curl command we should use so SRE can validate after cutover.
NetOps: Added EU fallback 18.197.45.12 (priority 100) and opened NET-423 for follow-up. Note: internal resolver still returned stale CNAME for the artifact bucket earlier — I pushed a TTL flush.
SRE Bot: Reminder: preflight test run window is 08:50–09:10 PST tomorrow. Will run automated health checks unless someone cancels.
SRE Bot: Health check script snippet: ```#!/bin/bash
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --resolve helix.private.redwood:443:10.1.2.3 https://helix.private.redwood/healthz || exit 1
# expect 200 and JSON {"status":"ok"}```
Ryan: Smoke curl I used locally: `curl -v --resolve helix.private.redwood:443:10.1.2.3 https://helix.private.redwood/healthz` — expect 200 and `{"status":"ok"}`.
JC: CR ping: my PR needs one more review from @Alex before I can merge. Tiny change, blocking image sync deploy.
Natalie: Cutover window proposal: canary 09:30–09:45 PST (10%), monitor 30m, then full roll at 10:15 if healthy.
Alex: Owners recap: Meera (network validation), Natalie (certs + rollout), JC (image sync), NetOps (egress + DNS). I'll run final go/no-go at 08:45 PST tomorrow. Post any blockers here — if nothing, we'll proceed with the dry-run. :thumbsup:
Meera: Verified artifact pull from staging mirror after perms fix. One remaining ask: on-prem firewall team needs the exact test IPs list; posting below.
NetOps: Test IPs: 10.1.2.3 (canary), 10.1.2.4 (control). Also public egress shown above for outbound.
Ryan: :thumbsup: Good to me, will standby for SRE run and logs.
Alex: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread as single source for morning updates. If you hit a blocker, ping here and DM me.
